facts.text: Snow left Pope Ridge (3,590 ft) and Trinity (2,890 ft) 7 to 20 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Pope Ridge
evidence.detail: left April 6; earlier seasons: May 6 (2023), April 22 (2024), April 26 (2025)

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: left May 1; earlier seasons: May 13 (2023), May 8 (2024), May 7 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at Pope Ridge (3,590 ft) and Trinity (2,890 ft).

evidence.name: Pope Ridge
evidence.detail: 3.6 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 19.8 in (2023), 9.3 in (2024), 14.3 in (2025)

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: 20.1 in on April 1; earlier seasons: 26.9 in (2023), 21.3 in (2024), 26.3 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 9 and June 8, carried from the melt-out dates at Pope Ridge (3,590 ft) and Trinity (2,890 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Pope Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out April 6, 800 ft below the pass; points to March 24 to May 17

evidence.name: Trinity
evidence.detail: melted out May 1, 1,500 ft below the pass; points to April 25 to June 29
